title: Cyclone Warning: Bay of Bengal System
description: Deep depression over west-central Bay of Bengal intensifying into a cyclonic storm. Gale winds up to 90 km/h and heavy coastal rain projected along Kakinada and Konaseema coast. Fishermen advised not to venture into sea.

title: Godavari & Krishna Riparian Flood Advisory
description: High upstream inflows increasing barrage discharge. Low-lying riparian settlements in East Godavari and Krishna districts advised to monitor local advisories and avoid submerged causeways.
source: State Disaster Management Advisory • Krishna Basin (Illustrative)

title: Coastal Inundation Advisory: Lowland Causeways
description: High astronomical tide combined with moderate coastal swells may cause localized waterlogging along Uppada Beach Road and coastal village access roads.
affectedArea: Uppada Beach Corridor, Kakinada District, AP
source: Coastal Ocean State Advisory • Uppada Corridor (Illustrative)
